news.t: Noah Cates News: Slides assist in loss

posts.t: Martone takes a shot from the slot, and it squeaks through Talbot... Noah Cates gets there first to push it over the goal line. Flyers on the board, now down 3-1. A gift, but it still required hustle from Cates and a shooting mentality from Martone to happen.
And replace him with who, honestly? Zegras? The guy who getting obliterated at center to start the season. Dvorak is basically equal to Cates.

Nice little pass by Kent Johnson through both Cates and Bonk on the 4-on-4 leaves Fantilli wide open in front. Vladar got some of it, but not enough to keep it from getting past him. 1-0 Blue Jackets.

Noah Cates acknowledged that ANA's first goal -- the bad handoff between Woll & Seeler --  "deflated" the team a bit.

"Guys got to step up and say, we're playing fine. One goal, it's whatever. We're still in the lead. We're still got ahold of this game if we play the right way."

threads.t: MICHKOV! His 2nd of the game gets PHI within one! Great play by Cates, Martone grabs the other assist.
